mentions.name: Private offline image organizer
mentions.description: A desktop app for browsing, tagging, and rating personal image collections. It reads files without modifying them and stores all data in a local SQLite database, positioning itself as a private, offline, easy-to-use alternative to the Eagle app.
mentions.source_excerpt: A desktop app to easily browse, tag, and rate your images. It doesn't touch your files, it just reads them. Everything is stored in a local SQLite database. Think Eagle app but private, offline, and easy to use.
